title: Game Developer
summary: Game developers write the code that makes a game work: player controls, game rules, menus and performance, usually in Unity (C#) or Unreal Engine (C++). They sit in a game studio team with designers and artists, and many Indian studios make mobile games.
dailyDuties: Build gameplay features in Unity or Unreal
Profile and improve frame rate and memory
Hook up art, animation and sound from the art team
Integrate ad, analytics and store SDKs
Review code and merge work in Git

skills.expectation: Build gameplay, UI and scenes in Unity
Build gameplay in Unreal Engine with C++ and Blueprints
Use vector math, physics and collisions in gameplay code
Structure game code with OOP and common game patterns
Profile frame rate and memory and fix the slow parts
Share work through Git with artists and other developers
Build multiplayer features with Photon or Netcode
Ship builds to the Play Store and App Store
Pick the right data structures for game systems
Integrate ad, analytics and backend SDKs
